title: routerPlugin
summary: Configure flat route discovery and development server transport.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: directory defaults to src/routes. To use manual tables, provide both clientRoutes and serverRoutes paths relative to the Vite project.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Vite plugin. fileRouter is an alias of routerPlugin.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Requires Vite 8 or newer. Import virtual:smolter/routes for the generated table. Server loader/action exports must be named re-exports from separate files. Export-star and inline server handlers, including destructured bindings and class declarations named loader/action, are rejected in browser route modules. Keep secrets and server initialization in the separate server module; route modules run in the browser. The plugin handles development requests; production still needs a server adapter.

sections.title: Request body limit (0.5.2)
sections.body: Node createRequestHandler and Vite applicationPlugins/routerPlugin default to maxBodySize: 1048576 (1 MiB). Oversized declared lengths are rejected before reading; chunked bodies are counted as received and return 413 before application handlers run. The limit includes multipart overhead and counts received bytes, not decompressed content. Configure the same finite, nonnegative integer in production and development for intentionally larger uploads; zero permits only empty bodies. Keep hosting timeouts, rate/concurrency limits and any decompression limits. Low-level webRequest accepts this limit as its fourth argument and throws a Response for policy or size rejection; the provided middleware sends it automatically.
